description: A visual asset designed to receive presentation text or layout outside the generated image.

cover: Create a launch-cover visual with quiet space on the right for a title.
section: Create a section-divider visual with a dark left-side text-safe area.
content-background: Create a restrained content background with broad central safe space.

prompt_guidance: State the focal subject, intended overlay area, hierarchy, crop tolerance, and presentation theme.
prohibited_content: Do not bake slide text into the image.
Do not generate charts as presentation data.
Do not generate slide-layout chrome or complete slide layouts.

aspect_ratio.description: The asset uses the requested presentation ratio.

safe_area.description: The requested title or content safe area remains usable.

theme_consistency.description: The visual supports the stated presentation theme.

visual_hierarchy.description: The focal hierarchy supports later slide composition.

overlay_contrast.description: The safe area can support readable overlaid content.

crop_safety.description: Important content tolerates the intended slide crop.
